ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the diagram of the interaction of water, air, and organisms in an agricultural system in a certain region of China. <image1> Among the numbers 1, 2, and 3 in the figure, which number represents the “evaporation” link in the water cycle?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure there is “irrigation,” with an arrow pointing to “soil moisture increases.” On the right side of “soil moisture increases” there is the number ①, and ① then points by an arrow to “air humidity increases.” The lower part of the figure also shows boxes such as “ground vegetation cover increases” and “transpiration strengthens,” and on the right side there are boxes such as “latent heat absorption increases” and “maximum temperature decreases.” Then reason: the question asks, among the numbers 1, 2, and 3, to find the “evaporation” link in the water cycle. Evaporation is the process by which soil or surface water changes into atmospheric water vapor, and it will increase air humidity. In the figure, ① happens to connect “soil moisture increases” and “air humidity increases,” which fits the effect of evaporation, so the one representing evaporation is ①.

Read the diagram of the interaction of water, air, and organisms in an agricultural system in a certain region of China.

<image1>

Among the numbers 1, 2, and 3 in the figure, which number represents the “evaporation” link in the water cycle?
